{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment ≤ 0.00) to correct for overconfidence.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% if recent 7-day true outcomes show mean reversion toward lower prices.",
    "If model overestimates after a sharp price spike (e.g., >15% above recent high), apply a decay factor to dampen the overshoot.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent low prices (last 5 days) if sentiment is positive (sentiment > 0.25) to avoid lagged reactions.",
    "Apply a smoothing filter to forecast series when sentiment is volatile (e.g., alternating +0.25/-0.25) to reduce noise-driven overfitting.",
    "If true outcome consistently exceeds forecast by >10% over 3 consecutive days, shift forecast baseline upward by 2-3% to align with trend.",
    "For long-term horizons (>14 days), reduce forecast volatility by 15-20% to account for structural mean reversion in carbon markets."
  ]
}
